definitions.gloss: directly under; direct subordination; reporting directly to
definitions.explanation: Being under the direct authority or supervision of someone without any intermediate level. Commonly used for organizational relationships in workplaces and military.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}{直属|ちょくぞく}のチームだ。
examples.english: It's a team that reports directly to the president.

examples.japanese: {直属|ちょくぞく}の{上司|じょうし}に{相談|そうだん}する。
examples.english: I'll consult with my direct supervisor.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{本部長|ほんぶちょう}{直属|ちょくぞく}の{部下|ぶか}として、{重要|じゅうよう}なプロジェクトを{任|まか}されている。
examples.english: As a direct subordinate of the division head, he has been entrusted with important projects.

notes:
Compound of {直|ちょく} (direct) + {属|ぞく} (belong to). Used as a の-adjective to modify nouns describing organizational relationships.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直属|ちょくぞく}の{上司|じょうし} — direct supervisor/boss
- {直属|ちょくぞく}の{部下|ぶか} — direct subordinate
- {社長|しゃちょう}{直属|ちょくぞく} — reporting directly to the president
- {直属|ちょくぞく}する — to be under the direct authority of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {所属|しょぞく} — belonging to, affiliation (does not imply direct reporting)
- {配属|はいぞく} — assignment, posting (being assigned to a department)
